items.summary: The S&P 500's streak came to an end, falling from its peak as weaker retail sales suggested caution among consumers. Despite a strong outlook, Applied Materials saw its shares slump, dragging down AI-related stocks. In contrast, rising oil prices helped lift the energy index. Reddit experienced a surge following news of its index inclusion.

items.title: Air India Phuket-Delhi flight lost hydraulics for seconds: Airbus asks airline to check if it was genuine failure or glitch
items.summary: An Air India flight experienced a rare hydraulic control loss, injuring 24 passengers. The aircraft's flight data recorders showed a sudden pressure drop across all systems. This incident caused the elevators and ailerons to briefly stop responding to pilot commands. While the captain is under scrutiny, initial data suggests no human error caused the event. Investigators are examining a hydraulic pressure switch to determine the exact cause.

items.title: India’s growth story, and its challenges -- in numbers
items.summary: Over the years, the economy has evolved dramatically—from rising incomes and a larger global footprint to deeper integration with the world economy and a shift towards services. India has come a long way, but significant challenges remain. Anoushka Sawhney takes a look.

items.title: Meta Says It’s Shut Down 750,000 Youth Accounts in Australia
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. says it has removed access to more than 750,000 Instagram and Facebook accounts in Australia believed to belong to people under 16 since it began complying with the country’s landmark youth social media ban last year.

items.title: Order it, pack it and deliver it: Q-commerce cos plan to bring large electronics orders home in 30 mins
items.summary: Quick commerce firms are engaging with manufacturers to boost sales of large appliances. Established e-commerce players are also striving for quicker delivery options. Some businesses are considering models that utilize manufacturer warehouses alongside retail locations. This strategic move is intended to elevate average order values and enhance profit margins, reflecting the evolving consumer demand for speedy delivery across various categories.

items.title: India cuts windfall tax on exports of petrol, diesel, aviation fuel
items.summary: India has reduced windfall taxes on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel exports. The duty on diesel exports is now 24 rupees per litre, while petrol duty is zero. Aviation turbine fuel exports will now face a 19.5 rupee per litre tax. These levies were first imposed in July 2022 and reintroduced in March 2026. India revises these export taxes every fortnight based on global oil prices.

items.summary: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to federal stalking charges in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO

items.title: Internship scheme aims to bridge skill gap among youth: Nirmala Sitharaman
items.summary: The PM Internship Scheme is designed to bridge the gap between industry requirements and the skill sets of job seekers. Recognizing a significant shortfall in skilled labor nationwide, senior industry leaders emphasized the need for enhanced workforce readiness. Thus, the government upgraded the scheme, raising stipends to ₹9,000 and lowering the eligibility age to eighteen. Now, final-year undergraduates can participate in this initiative from the corporate affairs ministry.

items.title: Wholesale inflation eases to 9.8% on softer energy prices
items.summary: In July, India's wholesale inflation decreased marginally to 9.8 percent, aided by falling energy prices which alleviated the pressures from increasing primary and manufactured goods costs. Conversely, retail inflation rose slightly to 4.5 percent, with food inflation peaking at a nineteen-month high, primarily due to hikes in prices of manufactured and primary food items. Predictions suggest wholesale price index inflation may dip below 9.5 percent next month.

items.title: SC slaps Rs 10 lakh fine on Reliance Industries for delaying NTPC gas supply suit
items.summary: The Supreme Court fined Reliance Industries ten lakh rupees for delaying a suit. NTPC filed the natural gas supply contract case against Reliance back in 2005. The court noted Reliance's continuous obstruction of the legal proceedings for two decades. This action came after the Bombay High Court's decision regarding witness affidavits. The apex court expressed strong disapproval of the prolonged litigation and its impact.

items.title: New Development Bank plans $7.5 billion funding to deepen rupee lending
items.summary: The New Development Bank is set to invest $7.5 billion in India, focusing on local currency financing aimed at strengthening emerging economies. By launching a rupee bond program, the bank aims to enhance India's domestic capital markets. This initiative reflects the bank's commitment to diversifying international financial structures, capitalizing on the substantial growth prospects that India's development presents.

items.title: Thermo Fisher finds India the perfect lab; lab equipment maker steps up investments as drug companies focus on innovation
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific is amplifying its investment footprint in India, driven by the strong anticipated growth in the biosimilars and innovative medicines sectors. With projections indicating a substantial rise in India's biosimilars exports by 2030, local pharmaceutical companies are pivoting towards advanced biologics and research initiatives. To foster scientific talent, Thermo Fisher has also established a bioprocess center in Hyderabad for comprehensive training.

items.title: Colleges bet on 'influencer' majors; critics ain't happy
items.summary: Arizona State University launched a new bachelor's degree in content creation, sparking debate. Many universities are now offering similar programs to attract students seeking new careers. Content creation is a time-consuming and labour-intensive job, often with low initial pay. While the creator economy is growing, most revenue does not go to individual creators.

items.title: Govt mulls single-window clearance for space sector
items.summary: The government is actively considering a single-window system designed for space sector approvals, aiming to enhance efficiency in business operations and notably cut approval durations. Multiple departments have engaged in discussions to create this inter-ministerial platform for shared applicants, addressing the longstanding demand from the space industry for reduced regulatory difficulties. This system's implementation is set to streamline the application process for diverse space ventures.

items.title: Neo Wealth buys a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv
items.summary: Neo Wealth Partners acquired a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv for Rs 230 crore. This investment supports Keertana's expansion in the growing gold loan market. Other firms like Bain Capital and Tata Capital are also active in this sector. Keertana aims to grow its portfolio to Rs 6,000 crore by March 2027. The Indian gold loan market is projected for significant future growth.

items.title: Delhi Master Plan 2047 approval likely to boost real estate sector
items.summary: The Master Plan 2047 has been greenlit by the Delhi Development Authority and is pending final approval from the government. This initiative seeks to clarify the landscape of real estate in the city, streamlining business operations by simplifying clearance processes. It tackles land scarcity issues with a focus on redevelopment in key zones, and experts predict it will greatly influence the property market in the national capital.

items.title: Pocket pinch: Rising millet prices may raise cost of packaged food
items.summary: Millet prices are increasing as farmers plant less of these nutritious grains. Lower planting this year could further tighten supplies and raise food costs. Jowar prices saw an 11% year-on-year increase in July, while small millets rose over 21%. Inflation in ready-made food products also climbed to nine percent. Wholesale prices for jowar and ragi indicate higher input costs for manufacturers.

items.title: Nvidia’s $500 billion plan envelops Wall Street in its AI frenzy
items.summary: Nvidia has unveiled a major financing initiative aimed at supporting artificial intelligence chip acquisitions. By collaborating with prominent financial institutions, the plan seeks to provide substantial debt solutions tailored for AI startups. This multifaceted financing strategy is designed to address the skyrocketing demand for computing power, ultimately fostering the essential digital and AI infrastructure development needed in the tech industry.

items.title: Mitsubishi agrees to pay NTPC Rs 851 crore to exit Farakka project
items.summary: Mitsubishi is nearing an exit from NTPC's Farakka power project. The Japanese firm will compensate NTPC with ₹851 crore for the project. This agreement follows earlier compensation demands and offers between the two companies. Significant work remains incomplete on the flue gas desulphurisation equipment installation. The project was initially estimated at ₹1,000 crore when awarded six years ago.

items.title: ICICI Bank seeks to raise $1.45-billion loan from a BofA-led consortium
items.summary: ICICI Bank is seeking a substantial $1.45 billion loan from a banking consortium. Bank of America is leading the syndicate, which includes several international banks. This four-year loan aims to attract leveraged investors to the FCNR-B deposit program. The Reserve Bank of India is absorbing currency hedging costs for these deposits. Funds will support overseas clients making foreign currency deposits with the bank.

items.title: SAT allows Zee, Goenka to proceed with warrant issue
items.summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal has granted Zee Entertainment and Punit Goenka the go-ahead for a convertible warrants issuance. However, this approval is contingent on the appellants depositing the entire penalty imposed by Sebi. The tribunal highlighted the strong approval from public shareholders for the investment proposal, indicating that this warrants issue could substantially benefit them. Additionally, the deadline for issuing these warrants has been extended by a week.

items.title: Forex reserves soar to $707 billion, highest so far in current fiscal
items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves increased by $14.1 billion to $707 billion. Foreign currency assets rose by $9.9 billion, and gold reserves gained $3.9 billion. These reserves have now declined from their earlier peak of $728 billion. Further inflows are expected from FCNR(B) and ECB schemes until August 31. The Reserve Bank of India received $56.8 billion in foreign currency inflows.

items.title: Irish House parent K Hospitality bets ₹550 crore on UK-based Wagamama’s India expansion
items.summary: K Hospitality plans to open over one hundred Wagamama outlets across India. The company has allocated five hundred fifty crore rupees for this significant expansion. This investment will scale up the popular Asian fare chain throughout the country. Consumer feedback has been very positive since the brand's initial launch last year. The company anticipates continued strong growth in system-wide sales.

items.title: Sugar stock scrutiny on the rise as prices hit record high
items.summary: The government is increasing scrutiny of sugar stocks due to surging prices. Large industrial buyers are now providing consumption data to the food ministry. Sugar mills must now detail sales of 500 metric tonnes or more annually. Physical stock checks are being conducted at mills across various states. This action follows observations of discrepancies in reported sugar stock data.

items.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
items.summary: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

items.title: India open to more shape, colour in bathware: David Kohler, CEO, Kohler Co.
items.summary: Bathware giant Kohler plans to invest at least $100 m over the next decade in the country, where it expects bathrooms to evolve with smart technology.

items.title: How a $900 million bet on SpaceX turned 100x into $94 billion for Alphabet
items.summary: Alphabet's initial $900 million SpaceX investment is now worth approximately $94 billion. This significant return makes Alphabet the largest institutional shareholder in the rocket company. Other early backers like Fidelity Investments and Saudi Arabia's PIF also hold substantial stakes.

items.title: Festive season alert: In Ghaziabad, 868 kg paneer & 170 kg khoya destroyed amid adulteration concerns
items.summary: Food safety officials have intensified action against dairy product adulteration. Recent raids in Ghaziabad resulted in the destruction of paneer and khoya. This follows a major seizure of contaminated paneer and milk in Mathura. Authorities are conducting a nationwide campaign against food adulteration. Consumers are advised to check packaging and report suspicious products.

items.title: RBI may stay nimble on rates as growth is seen slowing to 6.6%: Report
items.summary: Crisil reports India's growth may slow to 6.6 percent this fiscal year. Foreign portfolio investor inflows improved significantly in July, boosting financial conditions. Systemic liquidity surplus widened, and money market rates softened during July. Bank credit growth remained strong, and bond yields declined, while the rupee weakened. The Reserve Bank of India may remain flexible on policy rates due to these factors.

items.title: Patanjali Foods shares to be in focus on Monday as Q1 net profit jumps 86%; revenue hits record
items.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a robust June-quarter performance, with net profit increasing by 86% YoY to ₹335.73 crore and the highest-ever revenue of ₹11,337.45 crore. A 40% interim dividend has also been declared for FY27.

items.title: SRA targets over 5 lakh rehabilitation homes by 2030, plans 19 cluster redevelopments
items.summary: The SRA has set an ambitious goal to construct over 500,000 homes by the end of 2030. To facilitate this, annual targets will hasten slum redevelopment initiatives throughout the area. Innovations like amnesty programs and collaborative models are introduced for projects that have stalled. Additionally, a digital framework and computerized systems will enhance operational efficiency, while the Dharavi redevelopment is advancing through three distinct phases.

items.title: Govt to scrap 12-minute-per-hour advertisement cap for TV channels
items.summary: The government has removed the 12-minute per hour advertisement cap for television channels. This decision follows sweeping changes in the broadcasting landscape and a growing number of channels. The restriction, introduced in 2006, is being lifted to ensure fair competition and ease of business. Previously, the Delhi High Court had upheld this advertisement duration restriction. The amendment to the Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994, will be notified soon.

items.title: HC stays FSSAI ban on pre-packed whisky, rum of Khargone firm
items.summary: The Madhya Pradesh High Court has stayed an FSSAI order banning whisky and rum sales. This interim order was passed on August 6, preventing the ban's immediate effect. The court cited the regulator's failure to consider the company's reply to its notice. The company argued that its products comply with excise laws and challenged FSSAI's jurisdiction. The High Court has directed the Centre to file its response within four weeks.

items.title: CBI arrests 5 North Western Railway officials in separate bribery cases
items.summary: The CBI has taken decisive action against corruption by arresting five North Western Railway officials in Jaipur and Bikaner. These arrests, made on Thursday, stem from separate bribery cases involving officials who accepted payments to expedite company bill processing. An initial recovery of Rs 1.46 lakh was made, with extensive searches unveiling another Rs 9 lakh related to these cases, and an additional Rs 1.

items.title: Global energy, weather risks threaten further easing in wholesale inflation: Economists
items.summary: Wholesale inflation is expected to stay high despite a slight decrease in July. Global energy prices and geopolitical uncertainty pose ongoing risks to price moderation. Manufacturing costs remain elevated, contributing to sustained wholesale price pressures. Economists predict inflation will remain high for much of the year. A gradual decline in wholesale inflation is anticipated with easing energy costs.

items.title: Group including Jeff Bezos buys minority stake in Liverpool FC, with option to become controlling owner
items.summary: The group that includes Jeff Bezos has an option to become the majority shareholder within the next year.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase debanks Polymarket over regulatory concerns: Report
items.summary: JPMorgan retains other ties to Polymarket as it looks to leave the door open for an underwriting role should it attempt to go public, the report said.

items.title: Alphabet's $900 million SpaceX bet soars to $94 billion after rocket firm's IPO, filings show
items.summary: Alphabet's $900 million investment in SpaceX is now worth about $94 billion, making it the rocket firm's largest reported institutional holder after its IPO, filings show.

items.summary: A U.S. appeals court has ruled in favor of Gilead Sciences against companies known as alternative funding programs that import medicines from overseas.

items.title: Gold jumps 9% in August as weaker dollar, easing Fed bets boost demand
items.summary: Gold prices are on a winning streak as US Fed rate hike expectations ease and a weaker dollar boosts overseas demand. Spot gold reached $4,397 an ounce, marking a 9% monthly gain in August, while remaining below January's all-time high of $5,602.

items.title: ‘Gold can become a key pillar of India’s growth story’

items.title: India opens nuclear sector to private, foreign players under tight rules
items.summary: India has proposed a supervised approval regime for private nuclear projects. Foreign reactor technologies with proven overseas track records are now eligible for consideration. Developers will face extensive safety reviews throughout each project's lifetime. Regulators can halt progress at critical development stages, ensuring oversight. This move opens India's nuclear sector to private and foreign investment.

items.summary: Patanjali Foods posted strong Q1FY27 growth, with revenue rising 29.33% to ₹11,337 crore and operating EBITDA climbing 69.2%. Gross profit increased 35.22%, while the company declared two interim dividends, supported by record revenues and stronger execution across businesses.

items.title: US says India, 40 others enabling Chinese goods to bypass tariffs
items.summary: India has requested further information from the US regarding the claims of a shadow trans-shipment network. According to a US report, Chinese exporters are allegedly routing goods through more than forty countries to avoid tariffs, specifically targeting India's Pune-Gujarat-Chennai corridor for pumps and compressors. The GTRI advises India to examine its manufacturing and export data to confirm these allegations.

items.title: Mahindra unveils Scorpio Lifestyler pickup truck: Check price, features and launch date
items.summary: Mahindra unveiled its new Scorpio Lifestyler pickup truck for global markets. This new vehicle will launch in India by April 2027. The automaker plans to price the entry-level model below nineteen point seven nine lakh. It combines pickup utility with SUV comfort and features. The Scorpio Lifestyler will also be sold internationally.

items.summary: Fast-track route proposed for cases up to ₹10 lakh; settlement window extended to 60 days pre-SCN and 90 days post-SCN

items.title: Global Markets: Hotter Europe isn't cooling investor fervor for stocks
items.summary: The heatwaves pummelling Europe this summer will have costly impacts on industries ranging from agriculture to tourism -- but that hasn't stopped stock markets from hitting all-time highs. The Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid and Milan exchanges all hit records in August, in line with recent all-time highs for Wall Street's key indexes.

items.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
items.summary: Accel India IV has completed the sale of a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company as of August 13, 2026. The Mauritius-based investor offloaded 2 crore equity shares via open market deals, trimming its stake to 4.84 percent. Urban Company stands out with a total equity share capital exceeding 154 crore shares, further emphasizing its scale in the home services market.
